prose:
An anonymous Comentr post reports Gemini twice beginning to output the lyrics of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, then withdrawing them and displaying a refusal. The accessible text consists of that short account and reactions, with screenshots offered as supporting material.

This is a single user report, not a reproduced test of a specified model, prompt, account or region. The screenshot contents were not independently inspected here, and commenters' copyright explanations are not a verified explanation of the refusal. The post cannot establish a general Gemini policy or a measured over-refusal rate.
highlights: Text does not establish the exact tested configuration
Screenshots are linked but not independently inspected
No test was run against Gemini
